description.p: AUCDataTool opens the raw data of analytical ultracentrifugation (AUC) experiments and shows the scans of every cell and channel, the run conditions and the timing of the scans. It is a reimplementation of the AUC-Viewer of AG Cölfen, University of Konstanz.

ul.li: Reads openAUC/UltraScan .auc files, Beckman XL-A/XL-I and Optima exports, and multi-wavelength .mwrs and .mw data
Absorbance from intensity against a reference channel or a radial region, wavelength averaging and spectra
Run conditions: rotor speed, temperature and ω²t of every scan
Scan timing: intervals between scans, skipped cells and detector sweep logs
Follows a folder while a run is recorded
3D surface view, export to CSV, Origin, Beckman XL and UltraScan .auc, printing

screenshot.caption: A multi-wavelength run: absorbance against the reference channel

description.p: Update notifications with one-click download, file associations for .auc, .mw, .mwrs and Beckman XL scan files, and line and marker styles for every plot.
Linux: packages for older distributions (glibc 2.28), native Wayland, a launcher and an icon. Windows: application icon.
Scan timing analysis, detector sweep logs, automatic fringe-jump limits and a reworked interface.
